tool_args.title: Incident Post-Mortem: INC-8892 - Distributed PostgreSQL Telemetry Cluster Outage
tool_args.content:
# INC-8892 Post-Mortem: Distributed PostgreSQL Telemetry Cluster (Prod US-East)

## Incident Summary
- **Severity:** SEV-1 (CRITICAL)
- **Impact:** Replication lag exceeded 450s during peak traffic, triggering automatic failover that caused a temporary split-brain partition and corrupted telemetry sequence IDs.
- **Affected Service:** Distributed PostgreSQL Telemetry Cluster (Prod US-East)

## Root Cause Analysis
1. Peak traffic spike saturated network I/O and replication pipelines.
2. Replication lag crossed safety thresholds, initiating automated failover.
3. Split-brain partition occurred due to lack of consensus raft leader election.
4. Concurrent writes led to conflicting telemetry sequence IDs.

## Preventive Action Plan
- Implement Patroni consensus raft leader election with etcd.
- Add sequence ID replay deduplication layer in Redis.
- Configure Datadog synthetic canary alerts for replication lag > 30s.
